title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for CKD and hypertension.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well but notes occasional fatigue and mild swelling in his lower extremities. He has been adherent to his current medication regimen and denies any acute changes in urinary output or severe shortness of breath. He is here to monitor his blood pressure and renal function.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. Vital signs show stable blood pressure. Physical exam reveals no significant edema in the lower extremities and clear breath sounds. No active rashes or lesions noted.

Assessment
1. CKD, stage 4
2. hypertension

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and CKD. The patient will undergo a laboratory panel to monitor glomerular filtration rate and electrolyte levels. We will repeat the blood pressure check at the next visit. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
